examples: Keep a ashfield group and a backend group so a glance at the drawer tells you which side each agent is on.
Pin the one session you check most often so it never scrolls away.
how_to: Open an agent's menu, choose add to, then group, and pick a group; a group's own menu, add, pulls agents in.
Drag a row by its grip to reorder it within its group, or drag a whole band to reorder groups.
Pin a row with the pin mark to keep it at the top. Pins, order and colors follow you to every device.
Give a group an icon from its heading menu, icon: pick one from the grid or choose no icon. It shows in the group's color, right of the chevron.
name: Session groups
summary: organize sessions into named groups in the sidebar, with pins, colors and icons that stick.
where: The agents drawer: groups are the named bands above the ungrouped sessions.
Move a session into one with its row menu, add to, then group.
A group's icon: its heading menu (the three dots), icon.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
